arms.baseline: Scientific target identity, POS, sense, root and national correspondence; no external morphology, graph, rules or alternative hints
arms.evidence: baseline plus independently verified exact-scope evidence, including refutations
arms.graph: evidence plus documented directed morphological graph with intermediate scopes and source dependencies
arms.rules_alternatives: graph plus installed normative definitions and explicitly checked alternative origins/senses
arms.hybrid: same raw rules_alternatives prediction, then deterministic ABSTAIN for missing independent fact review or ANY registered high-risk flag; preserve raw and routed verdict

candidate_policy: All locally installed attested non-cloud models eligible; Qwen/DeepSeek only if available and revision pinned. No external provider/model approved. Do not rank model brands. This is not a survey of all commercially available models.
required_execution_registration: qualified human calibration certificate and immutable gold artifact
preserved old holdout digest and exposure inventory
identical response schema across arms and validated runner
frozen arm schedule and missingness policy
independent scientific and statistical reviewer signoff
split_policy: New calibration and development must be independently collected outside preserved holdout groups. Prompt21 reserve is provisional and is not automatically an LLM calibration/dev set. Never split old holdout into tuning subsets. No holdout predictions before final registration. Transitive leakage linkage must be externally verified.

execution.schedule: seeded randomized paired model/arm order within case; freeze full schedule before requests; one primary pass, no best-of reruns
execution.tuning: calibration fits empirical reliability only; development selects model/arm, routing and fixed risk gates; freeze before one holdout evaluation
execution.baseline_policy: Same scientific problem and response schema, but no external evidence restriction preventing INCLUDE/EXCLUDE; these remain unverified proposals

measurement.dangerous_false_exclusion_rate: FN/all gold INCLUDE, including model abstentions in denominator
measurement.membership_recall: TP/all gold INCLUDE, abstentions count as missed positives
measurement.exclusion_recall: TN/all gold EXCLUDE, abstentions count as missed negatives
measurement.abstain: model ABSTAIN/all received model decisions; transport/schema failures reported separately over assigned requests
measurement.calibration: Do not solicit confidence or change normative prohibition. Fit empirical reliability of predeclared observable evidence/risk bins on separate calibration gold, freeze bins and support; report predicted risk vs observed error, reliability diagram/Brier on untouched holdout with uncertainty. NOT IMPLEMENTED; no values without data.
measurement.senses: exact verified sense ID accuracy and missingness separately
measurement.rationales: independent qualified humans audit every atomic factual claim, citation entailment, source identity/version/scope, contradictory evidence and alternative analysis. Citation validity alone is insufficient; two LLMs are not independent gold.
measurement.uncertainty: Diagnostic Wilson intervals are not population certification. Final analysis requires preregistered grouped/stratified bootstrap (seed fixed, 10000 resamples), paired case comparison, design weights for probability holdout; challenge sets separate. Do not claim independence of correlated family/source observations.
measurement.cost: separate provider-rated vs invoice-reconciled cost; usage per request, hardware cost unknown unless measured
measurement.speed: p50/p95 generation latency, cold/warm context, tokens/sec and wall throughput; independent human annotation timing required for human speedup claims

candidate_gates_proposed_not_production_.scope: Research selection gates, not changed linguistic thresholds. All must pass on untouched holdout with sufficient per-stratum effective support. Empty strata or unknown facts block promotion. Allomorph/historical false exclusions require individual review; systematic rejection disqualifies candidate. No winner if none pass. Manual-only/no winner is valid.

registration_limit: Only method locked now. Complete execution preregistration and actual benchmark remain BLOCKED; do not backdate or silently fill pinned models after viewing outcomes.
